reality: SSC CGL is the main route for Inspector posts. IRS via UPSC CSE.
Income Tax Inspector: field work (raids, surveys) + office work (assessment).
Customs Inspector: airport/seaport/land border duty. Irregular hours.
Tax Assistant: desk job, data entry, processing returns. Less field work.
Physical standards strict for Customs. Color blindness disqualifies.
Salary: Inspector ~₹44,900 (Level 7) + DA + HRA. IRS Officer ~₹56,100 (Level 10).

faq.q: What is the difference between Income Tax Inspector and Customs Inspector?
faq.a: Income Tax Inspector: assesses income tax, conducts raids/surveys, office-based. Customs Inspector: customs clearance at ports/airports, anti-smuggling. Different departments (CBDT vs CBIC).

faq.q: Can a commerce graduate apply for revenue jobs?
faq.a: Yes. Any graduate can apply for Tax Assistant and Inspector posts via SSC CGL. IRS via UPSC CSE. Commerce background helps but is not mandatory.

faq.q: What is the age limit for revenue jobs?
faq.a: Tax Assistant: 18-27 years. Inspector: 18-30 years. IRS: 21-32 years. Age relaxations for SC/ST/OBC/PwD.

faq.q: Is there negative marking in revenue exams?
faq.a: Yes. SSC CGL Tier 1: 0.50. Tier 2: 0.25. No negative marking in typing/skill tests.

faq.q: How many vacancies are there in revenue?
faq.a: Income Tax: 500-1000 (Inspector) annually. Customs: 300-500. Total revenue vacancies exceed 3000 per year via SSC CGL.

faq.q: Where do I find official revenue notifications?
faq.a: ssc.gov.in (SSC CGL), upsc.gov.in (IRS). SarkariJobs+ links the official notification on every listing.
